source: Original deterministic synthesis; no third-party samples.

running_foley.timing_authority: The referenced animation durations and contact cues determine cadence independently of display FPS; frontal and ascent shots continue those same phases.
running_foley.scheduling: One continuous global contact table from 39 to 55 seconds; the frontal cut at 42 and ascent at 47 advance the same actor phases without retriggering. One source per actor and near/far contact; no rhythm or guessed footstep loop is baked into the sources.

ascent_perspective.camera_source: cinematic_bridge_ascent.actor_states_at, acoustic_sources_at and project_world; no image loading
ascent_perspective.sampling: 481 inclusive camera-derived acoustic samples at 60 Hz, linearly interpolated for live and absolute-frame offline PCM.
ascent_perspective.falloff: Additional actual camera-source distance beyond the entry reference; footsteps (4/(4+extra_distance_m))**1.45 and breathing (2/(2+extra_distance_m))**1.7. Existing entry levels are preserved.
ascent_perspective.pan: Actual projected source position, blending from the existing frontal pan over 1.2 seconds; no camera-side discontinuity.

factory_sources.falloff: Entry-calibrated (entry_distance/current_distance)**1.2, capped at 1.25; source azimuth remains audible behind the camera.

ascent_perspective.channels: One reinforcement group lease plus the existing three ambience leases and at most three party contacts: seven owned effects plus the separately owned wind fit eight channels.

reinforcement_group.synthesis: Original Crown near/far boot and gear sources combined at all eight guard contact phases; circular tails and a distant low-pass filter preserve the loop seam.
reinforcement_group.contact_strengths: Small deterministic variation across three cycles; contact times retain the exact shared 800 ms guard cadence.
reinforcement_group.falloff: (45/(45+camera_to_group_centroid_distance_m))**1.15 with a smooth 0.8 second entrance. One source remains attached to the actual moving group centroid.
reinforcement_group.channel: One owned effects lease; no per-soldier channels.

frontal_breath.source: Unvoiced band-limited air, three varied inhale/exhale phrases approximately 1.2 seconds apart; independent synthesis seed.
frontal_breath.channel: Reuses the silent industrial warning lease from the frontal cut; no additional mixer channel.
